name: ceramics-api
description: Ballerina HTTP service exposing the store's product catalog, cart, checkout, order, and admin-management endpoints behind the platform's API gateway. Owns all business data (products, inventory, carts, orders, payments) in ceramics-db, calls Stripe to capture card payments, and sends the order-confirmation email via SendGrid. Validates Thunder-issued bearer tokens to distinguish guest, signed-in Shopper, and Store Admin callers; does not render any UI.

dependencies.name: ceramics-db
dependencies.description: Stores products, categories, customers, carts, orders, order items, and payment records.

dependencies.name: user-auth
dependencies.description: Validates bearer tokens issued by Thunder to resolve the caller's role (Shopper vs Store Admin) for protected endpoints.

dependencies.name: stripe
dependencies.description: Card payment capture for checkout via the Stripe Payment Intents API (create/confirm a PaymentIntent per order). PRD names Stripe as the reference payment provider.

config.description: Stripe secret API key used to create and confirm payment charges.

dependencies.name: sendgrid
dependencies.description: Sends the transactional order-confirmation email after a successful checkout via the SendGrid v3 Mail Send API (POST /mail/send).

config.description: SendGrid API key used to authenticate Mail Send API calls.
